title: What they said at the time

clips.q: It will be the next major consumer electronics standard.
clips.who: **Trip Hawkins**, at the Consumer Electronics Show, The New York Times, Jan 8, 1993[^19]

clips.q: It’s wonderful hardware, and it clearly raises the bar.
clips.who: **Robert F. Kleiber**, analyst, Piper Jaffray, The New York Times, Jan 8, 1993[^19]
**Michael Murphy**, California Technology Stock Letter, The New York Times, Sep 9, 1993[^20]
**Steven Blank**, president of the developer Rocket Science, on the royalty surcharge, The New York Times, Dec 11, 1994[^23]

clips.q: We like to joke about the Bank of Trip.
clips.who: **Trip Hawkins**, The New York Times, Dec 11, 1994[^23]
**John Taylor**, analyst, L.H. Alton & Co., on Hawkins leaving the Electronic Arts chair, Los Angeles Times, Jun 22, 1994[^22]

clips.q: If you look at the original concept, we had all our eggs in one basket, and we didn’t have control of the basket.
The game business climate right now dictates that we make hits and conserve cash.
clips.who: **Hugh Martin**, president of 3DO, Los Angeles Times, Sep 17, 1996[^25]

clips.q: Market conditions for us appeared to take a turn for the worse when the war with Iraq began.
We acquired the rights to The 3DO Company brand, not the 3DO console brand. Although they may seem identical, they are legally different.
clips.who: **Işık Şekercigil**, Empire Interactive, to Time Extension, Jul 2026[^35]
